about.description: There's a reason baby content dominates social media. The AI Baby Dance trend combines universal appeal with cutting-edge AI to create videos that are impossible to scroll past. The sight of a baby doing perfectly coordinated dance moves triggers instant joy.

items.title: Universal Appeal
items.description: Babies are the ultimate content. Add dancing? Unstoppable. These videos work across all demographics, languages, and cultures. Grandparents share them, teens repost them.

items.title: High Watch Time
items.description: TikTok's algorithm rewards videos people watch multiple times. Baby dance videos are so cute that viewers loop them 3-4x, sending your content to more For You pages.

faq.title: AI Baby Dance FAQ
faq.description: Common questions about making baby dance videos

items.question: What age babies work best?
items.answer: Any age from newborn to toddler works great. The AI is trained on various baby body proportions. Sitting babies and standing toddlers both produce adorable results.

items.question: Is it safe to post AI baby videos?
items.answer: The videos are clearly AI-generated, which most platforms now require disclosing. Many parents add 'Made with AI' in their caption. As with any child content, use your judgment about what you're comfortable sharing publicly.

items.question: Can I use old baby photos?
items.answer: Absolutely! Many parents are using photos from years ago. It's a fun way to create 'what if' videos of your now-teenager as a dancing baby, or to animate photos of relatives as babies.

items.question: Why do baby dance videos get so many views?
items.answer: Babies + dancing = dopamine. The cuteness triggers feel-good responses that make people watch multiple times and share with others. TikTok's algorithm detects high engagement and pushes these videos to more users.

items.question: What music is included?
items.answer: Each dance template comes with pre-synced, family-friendly audio. Options include upbeat pop, cute sound effects, and trending TikTok sounds that work well with baby content.

items.question: Can grandparents use this?
items.answer: Yes! We designed the interface to be simple enough for anyone. Upload photo → pick dance → generate. Many grandparents are creating videos of their grandkids and sharing in family groups.
